searchText: No, when the attestation is to the beacon block that was just proposed, the index should be set to 0 since there is no payload information, and having a single value makes aggregation better (though in principle we could also not enforce this on chain and just enforce it in the fork choice and p2p) Or not enforce it all and just have the honest behavior be attest with 0 but shouldn't the same attestation vote on the EMPTY vs FULL of the payload of the prev block? It does implicitly, by voting on the beacon block The only time when you’re explicitly voting on payload information is when you vote for a block in the past, that does not have another beacon block extending it and making a payload decision. Otherwise you always do it implicitly Ah I see, yeah this makes sense, thanks!
